## R Markdown

```{r}
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(dae)
```


```{r}
f=read.csv("file")
```


```{r}
## X1 Y1 X2 Y2 X3 Y3  
f1=stack(f, select=c("X1","X2","X3"))
f2=stack(f,select=c("Y1","Y2","Y3"))
f3=cbind(f1,f2)
names(f3)=c("x","xtrt","y","trt")
f3$trt=ordered(factor(f3$trt))
```


```{r}
plot(f3)
prec=aov(x~trt,data=f3)
summary(prec)
```


```{r}
plot(f3$y~f3$x,xlab="X",ylab="Y")
resc0=aov(y~trt, data=f3)
summary(resc0) 
summary(aov(y~x,data=f3));
```


```{r}
resc=aov(y~trt+x, data=f3)
resc$coefficients
summary(resc) 
Anova(resc, type="III")
lsms=emmeans(resc, ~trt)
pairs(lsms)
resc0=aov(y~trt, data=f3)
summary(resc0)
```

```{r}
prec=aov(x~trt,data=f3)
summary(prec)
summary(aov(y~x,data=f3))

```


```{r}
resc=aov(y~trt+x, data=f3)
resc$coefficients
Anova(resc, type="III")
```
